item.title: Gershwin-desktop: OS X-like Desktop Environment based on GNUStep
item.description:
📝 Gershwin is completely self contained from the underlying operating system. Local Users and Local Applications are kept seperate from Network Users and Network Applications and System Applications. Applications built using Gershwin and it's underlying GNUstep foundation can run on other many operating systems including Windows.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/gershwin-desktop/gershwin-desktop
